annotations.title: Edge Skills: run a live data tool (beta)

description: BETA. Run a read-only Edge data tool, free. For startup jobs call it directly with tool "rocketlist.search_jobs" and input like {"query":"engineer","city":["Berlin"],"stage":["Seed"]} (title, company, stage, location, salary, link per job); for totals (how many jobs or startups, top cities, companies, stages, pay) use "rocketlist.hiring_stats" with the same filters; "rocketlist.search_companies" lists hiring startups. Other tools: find_tool. List arguments are arrays. Cite each result's rocketlist_url.

detail.description: concise (default) keeps the essential fields per result; full returns every field

input.description: Arguments matching the tool's input_schema, as a JSON object

tool.description: The tool id from find_tool, e.g. rocketlist.search_jobs
